name: engagelab-agent-email
description: Send, receive, monitor and reply to email from AI agents.
long_description: Connect an AI agent to EngageLab Agent Email. Discover mailboxes, send email, monitor inbound messages, inspect threads and reply with conversation context.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: List mailboxes available to the authenticated account. Call this first to discover mailbox IDs.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a new email with text or HTML content, recipients, and optional attachments.

tools.name: reply_email
tools.description: Reply to an inbound message while preserving the conversation thread.

tools.name: list_inbound_messages
tools.description: List inbound email messages, newest first, with optional mailbox and keyword filters.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Get the full details of an inbound message by message UID.

tools.name: check_new_messages
tools.description: Poll once for new inbound messages without blocking.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List conversation threads, optionally filtered by mailbox or keyword.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Get details of one conversation thread.

tools.name: list_thread_messages
tools.description: List all messages inside a conversation thread, oldest first.

secret_key.title: EngageLab Secret Key
secret_key.description: Secret Key from the EngageLab Agent Email console. It starts with sk_.

base_url.title: API Base URL (optional)
base_url.description: Leave empty to infer the region from your Secret Key.
